summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Treesh 3.0 single-file vanilla JS music app. Tested 13 core features including voice popup, accent colors, Treesh's Picks, mobile spacing, karaoke mode, lyrics features, game flow, search overlay, and section transitions. All core features working correctly. Found one critical UI bug with search overlay close transition.

ui_bugs.issue: Search overlay close transition leaves residual backdrop DOM that blocks all navigation when closed via UI click. The backdrop element <div data-act='search-close'> remains visible and intercepts all pointer events, preventing users from clicking any navigation elements.
ui_bugs.workaround: Calling closeSearch() via JavaScript works correctly and clears the DOM. The issue only occurs when user clicks the close button/backdrop in the UI.
affected_flows: Search -> Close -> Navigate to any tab

passed_tests: APP LOADS - No console errors on load, onboarding dismisses correctly
VOICE POPUP (P0) - Mic button opens overlay, overlay stays visible (not vanishing instantly), cancel/close button works
GOLD -> ACCENT COLOR - All eyebrow labels (TREESH 3.0, NEW MUSIC, MUSIC TO LIVE FOR) render in purple accent color rgb(147, 40, 255), not gold #c3ab69
TREESH'S PICKS - Exactly 6 pick cards visible, shuffle button changes cards correctly
MONO DEFAULT BACKGROUND - Fresh localStorage defaults to 'mono' background mode
MINI-BAR vs BOTTOM NAV OVERLAP (MOBILE) - 10px gap between mini-player and bottom nav, no overlap on 390x844 viewport
KARAOKE MOBILE OVERFLOW - No horizontal overflow on mobile (358px stage width < 390px viewport), transparent background rgba(0,0,0,0)
COPY LYRICS - Copy lyrics button exists and is clickable in Now Playing lyrics view
LYRIC AUTO-SCROLL PAUSE/RESUME - Manual scroll shows resume pill, clicking resume pill hides it correctly
FEATURED ARTIST PERFORMER PILL - #np-performer element exists in DOM (content depends on song section headers)
LYRIC GAME PARENTHESIS RULE - Game flow works end-to-end: 37 tracks available, game starts, input field works, verdict shown with points (+11), 'Next line' button continues game
SEARCH OVERLAY CLOSE - Opens correctly, closes cleanly via JS closeSearch() function
SECTION TRANSITIONS - Genre chip and view toggle work without errors, content updates correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix search overlay close transition bug: When user clicks the close button or backdrop to close the search overlay, ensure the DOM is completely cleared (especially the backdrop element). Currently, the backdrop remains and blocks all navigation. The closeSearch() function works correctly when called via JS, so the issue is likely in the click event handler or animation timing.
